title: Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank
abstract: arXiv:2608.16681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). translated_title: 弥合标记与未标记数据差距：基于统一流与特征记忆库的方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16681v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管半监督语义分割（$\text{S}^4$）利用大量未标记数据来减少人工标注负担，但标记数据和未标记数据的独立训练导致前者占主导地位，严重降低了伪标签的质量。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的遥感（RS）$\text{S}^4$方法，通过统一流与特征记忆库（UFFM）。具体而言，UFFM包含两个关键创新：统一流（UF）和特征记忆库（FMB）。UF是一种新的训练流程，通过将外部视觉基础模型（VFM）与遥感领域教师结合，生成偏差较小的伪标签，并在统一训练目标下联合优化标记和伪标记数据。FMB是一种新颖的$\text{S}^4$记忆模块，在训练过程中动态更新类特定特征，并通过类特征对齐减少标记和未标记数据之间的特征差异。
tldr: 本文提出UFFM方法，通过统一流结合视觉基础模型和领域教师生成更优伪标签，并利用特征记忆库动态对齐类特征，有效解决半监督语义分割中标记数据主导导致的伪标签质量下降问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes UFFM, which uses a unified flow combining a visual foundation model and a domain teacher to generate better pseudo-labels, and a feature memory bank for dynamic class-feature alignment, effectively addressing the pseudo-label quality degradation caused by labeled-data dominance in semi-supervised semantic segmentation.
